note: Recast from Fauna Sinica, Insecta vol. 17, Isoptera; the original is in Chinese. The species was described by Xia and He in 1980 (Contr. Shanghai Inst. Entomol. 1: 177—179) and is species 72 of that work; the distribution is recorded only from Yunnan (Simao). In that work the alate appears only in the generic description of Schedorhinotermes and is not described for this species, so it is not included. The original has several OCR corruptions (e.g. the character for 'fontanelle' misread as the character for 'fierce', and a garbled phrase about the width of the mandible), which have been corrected from the context; the values were not changed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Large soldier: head subrectangular, slightly longer (to the mandibular base) than its maximum width, widest at the posterior third, the sides nearly parallel and slightly constricted in the middle; mandibular tips strongly curved inwards and sickle-shaped, the left mandible with 2 marginal teeth and the right also with 2 marginal teeth, the 2nd marginal tooth smaller and distinctly projecting as a tooth; antenna 17-segmented; postclypeus raised, slightly concave in the middle of the anterior margin; tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Small soldier: head narrower and longer, distinctly narrowed posteriorly, the left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the right with 1 marginal tooth, antenna 16-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Large soldier: head orange-yellow, the mandibular tips dark brown, the mandibular bases concolorous with the head, anteclypeus pale, antennae pale yellow, pronotum and abdominal tergites straw-coloured, legs pale. Body sparsely hairy; the labral tip with a pair of apical setae, the hyaline area with a row of short brush-like setae along the anterior margin. Body medium-sized; head subrectangular, slightly longer (to the mandibular base) than its maximum width, widest at the posterior third, the sides nearly parallel and slightly constricted in the middle, the posterior margin broadly and roundly arcuate; in profile the dorsum slightly convex, slightly depressed only in front of the midpoint and slightly higher posteriorly, the postmentum projecting on the ventral side. Mandibular tips strongly curved inwards and sickle-shaped; the left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the right also with 2 marginal teeth, the 2nd marginal tooth smaller and distinctly projecting as a tooth. Labrum short and broad, its widest point projecting laterally near the posterior end, hexagonal, slightly wider than long, the apical notch and the notch at the middle of the anterior margin of the hyaline area rather shallow, divided into 2 lobes laterally, with a median groove on the dorsum running from the clypeus to the labral tip; anteclypeus rather short and broad, slightly incurved in the middle of the anterior margin; postclypeus larger and raised, slightly incurved in the middle of the anterior margin; fontanelle circular, situated behind the middle between the two antennal sockets, the facial surface in front of the pore concave as a longitudinal groove reaching the clypeus; antenna 17-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 variable in length, generally segment 2 slightly longer; postmentum slightly narrow. Pronotum rather broad, wider than the mesonotum and metanotum, narrower posteriorly on both sides, slightly emarginate in the middle of the posterior margin. Tibiae rather slender and long, spur formula 3:2:2; tarsi 4-segmented. Small soldier: colour and pilosity similar to the large soldier, the labral tip with a pair of apical setae, the hyaline area with a row of brush-like setae along the anterior margin. Body slightly smaller, head narrower and longer, distinctly broad in the anterior part of the sides and narrow posteriorly, widest behind the antennal sockets on both sides, distinctly narrowed backwards, the margins straight, the posterior margin roundly arcuate and projecting in the middle; in profile the dorsal margin of the head straight, the postmentum projecting on the ventro-dorsal side. Mandibles slender and long, the tips slightly more curved, slightly swollen on the outer side of the base; the left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the inner margin of the right mandible with 1 marginal tooth. Labrum longer, the tip extending beyond the mandibular tips, the sides constricted waist-like in the middle, the apical notch and the notch at the middle of the anterior margin of the hyaline area rather deep, with a median longitudinal groove on the dorsum, the hyaline areas on both sides forming two semicircular lobes; postclypeus rather raised, the middle of the notch of the anterior margin projecting as a small spherical surface; anteclypeus longer than the sides of the postclypeus, slightly incurved in the middle of the anterior margin. Fontanelle circular, the facial surface in front of the pore concave as a shallow longitudinal groove reaching the clypeus, situated in the middle between the two antennal sockets; the waist of the postmentum rather narrow, situated near the posterior end. Antenna 16-segmented, segments 2 and 3 subequal in length, segment 4 the shortest. Pronotum rather narrow, its width similar to that of the mesonotum and slightly narrower than the metanotum, the middle of the anterior margin rather projecting, not incurved in the middle, the median notch of the posterior margin distinct. Tibiae slender and long, 1.0—1.05 mm long, spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Measurements (mm, mean in parentheses; large soldier/small soldier): body length 4.50—5.20 (4.76)/3.00—3.15 (3.05); head length (to the mandibular tip) 2.47—2.77 (2.58)/1.50—1.60 (1.55); head length (to the mandibular base) 1.62—1.70 (1.66)/0.90—1.00 (0.95); head width (at the posterior third) 1.45—1.62 (1.55)/0.70—0.80 (0.75); head height 1.00—1.07 (1.04)/0.57—0.60 (0.58); left mandible length 1.12—1.17 (1.15)/0.65—0.75 (0.70); postmentum length 1.05—1.12 (1.08)/0.62—0.62 (0.62); postmentum maximum width 0.47—0.50 (0.48)/0.35—0.37 (0.36); postmentum minimum width 0.27—0.30 (0.28)/0.25—0.27 (0.26); pronotum length 0.65—0.70 (0.67)/0.45—0.45 (0.45); pronotum width 0.97—1.10 (1.04)/0.65—0.65 (0.65); mesonotum width 0.92—1.02 (0.98)/0.62—0.65 (0.63); metanotum width 0.97—1.05 (1.00)/0.65—0.70 (0.67); hind tibia length 1.40—1.47 (1.45)/1.00—1.05 (1.02).
